spine: 1. SSDB 無人維護且只能單機，被迫把 blob 壓在 1 MB；新需求要同時服務 2 KB 到 5 MB，且明講可放寬 durability。
2. 現成方案各卡在不同的軸（吞吐、空間、用途不符、維運、TTL 粒度、自造輪子）；SQLite 沒有明顯的洞，短處（約 100 KiB 以上檔案較慢）用壓縮繞開。
3. 兩層切分：Redis Cluster 的 16384 個 slot 分到節點，節點內以 multi-probe consistent hashing 分到 SQLite 分片；每個分片一個 writer 加一個唯讀連線池。
4. 分片的收益不對稱：寫入約 3.3 倍，讀取幾乎不變，因為 SQLite 的單一寫入鎖只卡寫入（推測，與後面 TTL 清理的實際事故互相印證）。
5. 放寬 durability（不每次 fsync、async_write）換低寫入延遲，代價是崩潰時有遺失視窗；這是需求的一部分。
6. async 寫入欠下一致性債：pending map 加 tombstone，所有讀取指令都要先查；SQLite 自身行為（freelist 不縮檔、單一寫入鎖）也要由 Blobasaur 補。
7. 遷移以新工作負載、雙寫加回填、client 切換三步完成，雙寫一個月零不一致後關閉 SSDB；線上三節點 p99 約 2 ms。

perspective.mechanism: SQLite 分片加單一 writer 加批次 commit 加 Redis Cluster slot，把一把寫入鎖複製成多把；壓縮把 blob 留在 SQLite 有利的大小區間；pending map 與 tombstone 讓 async 寫入對讀取可見。
perspective.tradeoff: 放寬 durability 與 async_write 換寫入延遲；靜態 slot 指派與離線 resharding 換簡單；SQLite 不縮檔與單一寫入鎖需要自行補強。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師評估自建 blob 或偏好儲存時，可用其需求篩選順序與採用前四問（遺失視窗、壓縮後大小分布、TTL 粒度、可否接受靜態 slot 與離線 reshard）作檢查表。

notes.quote: SSDB became unmaintained, which was an obvious operational risk.
notes.interpretation: 替換 SSDB 的第一個動機是無人維護。

notes.quote: SSDB is not a distributed system and can only run on a single node.
notes.interpretation: SSDB 只能單節點。

notes.quote: forcing us to cap blob sizes at 1 MB because latency degrades on larger payloads.
notes.interpretation: 單機的後果是 1 MB 的 blob 上限，原因是較大 payload 延遲劣化。

notes.quote: It needed to serve both 2 KB settings blobs and 5 MB chart layouts with single-digit millisecond latency.
notes.interpretation: 新系統需求涵蓋 2 KB 到 5 MB，延遲個位數毫秒。這是需求，不是線上實測的分 size 延遲。

notes.quote: Relaxed durability is acceptable
notes.interpretation: 需求清單另五項為 Redis 協定相容、跨 payload 大小的低延遲、內建壓縮、帶 TTL 的簡單 CRUD、多節點分區；放寬 durability 是需求的一部分。

notes.quote: Significantly lower throughput and higher resource usage.
notes.interpretation: ScyllaDB 被排除的理由。

notes.quote: it turned out to be severely suboptimal again for the use case in terms of performance and disk-space efficiency.
notes.interpretation: PostgreSQL 被排除的理由。

notes.quote: Has blob storage as one of the options, but is not primarily designed or optimized for it.
notes.interpretation: YugabyteDB 被排除的理由。

notes.quote: Had the right primitives, but again, not architected for high throughput multi-MB blob writes.
notes.interpretation: RocksDB 被排除的理由。

notes.quote: Severe operational complexity and resource requirements.
notes.interpretation: Ceph 被排除的理由。

notes.quote: SeaweedFS keeps appending before compaction, which can cause disk usage to grow uncontrollably.
notes.interpretation: SeaweedFS 的空間問題（來源用 can cause，貼文以「可能」呈現）。

notes.quote: It doesn’t support TTL per blob.
notes.interpretation: SeaweedFS 不支援每個 blob 的 TTL。

notes.quote: coarse lifecycle TTLs instead of exact key expiry.
notes.interpretation: S3 與 MinIO 只有粗粒度 lifecycle TTL。

notes.quote: Putting blobs directly on disk meant implementing atomic writes and write batching
notes.interpretation: 直接寫檔案得自己實作原子寫入與寫入批次。

notes.quote: SQLite pretty much gave us everything that the raw filesystem lacked.
notes.interpretation: 選 SQLite 的總結理由。

notes.quote: For small blobs, SQLite is up to 35% faster than raw filesystem I/O.
notes.interpretation: 來源用 up to，貼文寫成「最多快 35%」。

notes.quote: While raw files start to beat SQLite above ~100 KiB, we compress blobs before writing them.
notes.interpretation: 約 100 KiB 以上原始檔案較快，所以先壓縮。壓縮讓資料留在 SQLite 有利區間是作者對兩句話關係的解讀。

notes.quote: thankfully, 99% of our compressed values sit well below 100 KiB.
notes.interpretation: 壓縮後 99% 的 value 遠低於 100 KiB。

notes.quote: the keyspace is divided into 16384 hash slots using
notes.interpretation: Redis Cluster 式的 16384 個 hash slot，使用 CRC16（來源該句續接 CRC16）。

notes.quote: Each Blobasaur node owns a configured range of slots, and nodes discover each other via gossip.
notes.interpretation: 節點擁有設定檔指定的 slot 範圍，節點以 gossip 互相發現。

notes.quote: pointing to the owner node.
notes.interpretation: 送錯節點時回 MOVED 轉址指向擁有者（該句前半含 MOVED 字樣與反引號）。

notes.quote: At present, slot assignment is static in config.
notes.interpretation: slot 指派目前是靜態寫在設定檔的。

notes.quote: the only code change was switching from a single-node Redis client to a Redis Cluster client
notes.interpretation: 切換時應用程式端唯一的程式碼改動。

notes.quote: Each key maps to one shard via multi-probe consistent hashing.
notes.interpretation: 節點內以 multi-probe consistent hashing 把 key 對應到一個分片。

notes.quote: Each shard has a dedicated writer task fed by a bounded queue.
notes.interpretation: 每個分片一個專屬 writer，由有上限的佇列餵資料。

notes.quote: Instead of committing one key at a time, the writer drains a batch of pending writes from the queue
notes.interpretation: writer 一次取出一批待寫資料放進同一個 transaction。批次攤薄 commit 成本、batch_size 與尾端延遲的取捨是作者推測。

notes.quote: Reads go directly to a per-shard pool of read-only SQLite connections and can run concurrently with the writer.
notes.interpretation: 讀取走每分片的唯讀連線池，可與 writer 並行。

notes.quote: Resharding is currently an offline operation via the built-in CLI.
notes.interpretation: resharding 目前是離線操作。

notes.quote: shard migrate 4 5 --verify
notes.interpretation: 遷移指令範例，需先停伺服器。

notes.quote: The migration tool moves keys whose target shard changed.
notes.interpretation: 只搬目標分片改變的 key；加 --verify 會檢查位置並回報資料列數（來源另句）。
1 個分片、純 HSET。
16 個分片、純 HSET。
1 個分片、一半 HSET 一半 HGET。
16 個分片、一半 HSET 一半 HGET；約 2.1 倍為作者計算。
1 個分片、純 HGET。
16 個分片、純 HGET；比 1 分片多約 5.6% 為作者計算。

notes.quote: With 16 shards, write throughput increases 3.3x and median write latency drops from 8.2 ms to 2.1 ms.
notes.interpretation: 來源自己的歸納。中位數降到約四分之一、p99 只降約兩成為作者計算。

notes.quote: All runs used 100,000 keys, synchronous writes, and
notes.interpretation: 對照實驗設定：100,000 個 key、同步寫入、batch_size = 50（該句後續）。64 KiB payload 取自同節 setup 描述。

notes.quote: 64 KiB payloads
notes.interpretation: 對照實驗的 payload 大小。

notes.quote: We run zstd in production.
notes.interpretation: 支援 zstd、lz4、gzip、brotli 四種，線上用 zstd。

notes.quote: shrinking a 63.6 KiB payload to 5.5 KiB reduces its storage footprint from roughly 16 pages to roughly 2
notes.interpretation: 平均 63.6 KiB 壓成 5.5 KiB，約 16 個 page 到約 2 個；來源用 roughly，貼文寫「約」。

notes.quote: about 11x
notes.interpretation: 來源表列的平均壓縮比約 11 倍。

notes.quote: SQLite does not fsync on every transaction commit.
notes.interpretation: 放寬 durability 的具體機制；崩潰時可能遺失最近 commit 是作者推測。

notes.quote: acknowledges writes as soon as they enter the
notes.interpretation: async_write 在寫入進分片記憶體佇列時就回覆，早於 SQLite 批次 commit（該句續接 shard 的 memory queue, before the SQLite batch commits）。

notes.quote: queued writes are also placed in an in-memory pending map that reads check before querying SQLite.
notes.interpretation: pending map 的作用。

notes.quote: could return the old value from SQLite
notes.interpretation: DEL 後立刻 GET 的邊角情況，原因是佇列裡的 DEL 尚未 commit。

notes.quote: storing explicit tombstones in the pending map
notes.interpretation: 修法是在 pending map 存明確的 tombstone。

notes.quote: routing every read
notes.interpretation: 來源列出的讀取指令為 GET、HGET、EXISTS、TTL，全部先經 pending map（該句括號內列指令）。TTL 易被漏掉的說明是作者推論。

notes.quote: Early on, we noticed disk usage only grew, even after millions of keys expired or were deleted.
notes.interpretation: SQLite 檔不縮小的現象。

notes.quote: By default, SQLite keeps freed pages on an internal freelist for future writes rather than returning space to the OS.
notes.interpretation: 原因是 freelist。

notes.quote: to reclaim unused freelist pages within a set allocation (128 MB default).
notes.interpretation: vacuum 子命令回收額度預設 128 MB；另啟用 auto_vacuum = INCREMENTAL（來源另句含反引號）。

notes.quote: right after executing an incremental vacuum.
notes.interpretation: 每次增量 vacuum 之後立刻執行 wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)。

notes.quote: In production, our p99 write latency normally sat below 5 ms, but we occasionally saw spikes to 30 to 50 ms.
notes.interpretation: 過期清理造成的寫入延遲尖峰。

notes.quote: single write lock, stalling normal client batches.
notes.interpretation: 大型 DELETE 與分片主 writer 爭奪 SQLite 單一寫入鎖。來源章節標題為 Expiry cleanup has to share the writer。

notes.quote: (1,000 rows by default).
notes.interpretation: cleanup_chunk_size 預設 1,000 列。

notes.quote: eliminated the latency spikes without affecting correctness.
notes.interpretation: 切塊清理後延遲尖峰消失。

notes.quote: When we launched Kite Terminal mode, we pointed its workspace storage directly at Blobasaur.
notes.interpretation: 遷移第一步：新工作負載直接用 Blobasaur。

notes.quote: we updated the services to dual-write to both SSDB and Blobasaur while running a background migration for historical keys.
notes.interpretation: 遷移第二步：既有工作負載（如圖表偏好）雙寫加背景回填。

notes.quote: Reads went to Blobasaur first and fell back to SSDB on a cache miss or error.
notes.interpretation: 雙寫期讀取順序。

notes.quote: After running dual-writes for a month with zero discrepancies, we turned off SSDB.
notes.interpretation: 雙寫一個月零不一致後關閉 SSDB；選這個長度的理由是作者推測。

notes.quote: Our current Blobasaur deployment runs as a three-node (4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM) cluster.
notes.interpretation: 線上部署規模。

notes.quote: p99 latency across all commands stays around 2 ms on every node
notes.interpretation: 線上 p99 約 2 ms。

notes.quote: p50 sits between 250 and 550 µs.
notes.interpretation: 線上 p50 在 250 到 550 微秒。

notes.quote: p99 around 1.4 ms
notes.interpretation: HGET p99 約 1.4 ms；同句另有 HSET p99 約 2 ms（p99 sits around 2 ms）與 HDEL p99 多半低於 1 ms（mostly under 1 ms）。

notes.quote: Why SQLite (and Rust)
notes.interpretation: 章節標題；Blobasaur 以 Rust 寫成，以及協定為 Redis 協定（需求清單 Redis protocol compatibility）。

notes.quote: is a partial index
notes.interpretation: expires_at 欄位上的索引是 partial index。
